_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/StallRoaster/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, controller cell at [0,0,0]: the front cell at ground level under the outlet's column (west). One roasting stall: a bay of brickwork open at the front (north) and to the sky, its back wall (the back row) holding the flue; stalls stand side by side in a row along x (up to furnace.rowMax), sharing one chimney on one member's outlet, the others capped. No power and nothing moves: no input drives any part. Natural draught, in at the front (front, frontSide), through the charge, out at the flue mouth at the foot of the bay's back face, along the back flue and up the stack to the outlet. requires: the build's stages, brickwork and lining (build; the frame, iron, has none); the bay's contents: wood (the bed) or kindling (the bed burning), the charge's four courses ore1..4 (from the bed up), the same burning fire1..4 or roasted roasted1..4, and sulfur (in the roasted heap's crust); the front's walling, fronthalf or frontwalled (one at a time, none when open); and outletcap. The brickwork's texture is the stall's brick type's (bricks), and the walling's. outletCell: the stack's top cell, the chimney stood on its top; chimney: the shortest chimney, counted from the outlet up; heap: the full charge's top. See StallRoaster/README.md.

build._comment: The build's stages, in order. frame: the iron frame's grid recipe (with a hammer); placing it puts down the controller and its ghosts, and draws the frame part. Each stage then fits its requires when its materials are all in: brickwork, then lining. volumeBlocks: the stage's brick measured from the model, in blocks; its quantities are that at 2 fired bricks or 4 refractory bricks a block (the game's brick block recipes), rounded up, fire clay one per 2.5 refractory bricks. perClick stack: a click puts in as many of the held stack as are still needed. oneType: the first fired brick put in sets the stall's brick type (bricks), and the rest must match. front: not a stage, the front's loose walling, one fired brick of the stall's own type (sameType) a brick drawn: materials for the walled-up front (frontwalled), half of them for the half-walled (fronthalf), kept by the stall once given; places: the parts, one drawn at a time, none when open. outletCap: an item interaction, not a stage. The bay's contents and the walling are drawn once the lining is in, as is the cap (the curb is the lining's).

bricks._comment: The fired brick types the brickwork takes (every game:burnedbrick type), each with the block its bricks make and that block's texture: the renderer sets the shape's 'brick' code to the stall's type's base, with its overlays drawn over it (the brick course's cream brick under the type's colour); the front's loose walling takes it too. The stall's type is the first brick put in; until then no brick is drawn. A type missing here (another mod's) is refused.

furnace._comment: charge: rock a full charge holds (two stacks); courses, perCourse: the charge is drawn as its courses ore1.. up to ceil(rock / perCourse) (fire.. while it burns, roasted.. once roasted); minChimney: chimney blocks stood on the outlet, counted from it up; rowMax, rowAxis: stalls in a row, side by side along x, sharing one chimney.
